_about: Held-out retrieval cases. Gold = any indexed chunk containing every phrase (case-insensitive). Questions and gold phrases were written by the developer by reading documents with plain text search (not the retriever) before any retrieval variant was run; no retriever tuning was done afterwards. 'unfamiliar' companies were never used during development.
